subject.title: refactor(plugin-sdk): consolidate persistent dedupe claim loop

question: Should runClaimableDedupeClaimLoop become a supported public plugin SDK API, rather than keeping this consolidation behind a narrower approved shared boundary?
rationale: The patch deliberately updates the SDK baseline and public-export budget, which turns an internal three-caller refactor into an external compatibility commitment that tests alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the narrow public helper
options.body: Keep the exported helper as a generic persistent-dedupe primitive, with its caller-owned settlement policy documented by focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep consolidation non-public
options.body: Redesign the sharing boundary so the refactor does not add a new supported plugin SDK callable.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow public helper
recommendation.body: Keep the exported helper as a generic persistent-dedupe primitive, with its caller-owned settlement policy documented by focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this proposed SDK boundary and all migrated call sites to steipete's current change.
